name: Morc
text: Morc is a Fomorian named in the roster of that hostile people of Irish story. The record keeps only one deed for him: he emigrated from Africa before the great battles of the Fomorians against the Tuatha Dé Danann.

attributes.attribute: Fomorian figure named in the census of that race
emigrant from Africa in Fomorian tradition

okr.objective: Documents Morc as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Morc is one of the often-cited Fomorians.
His single recorded deed is emigration from Africa.
